mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below historical average during easing periods, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.5% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing below 3.5%, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS and rises in GDPC1 signal a dual easing cycle: lower interest rates and stronger demand simultaneously boost equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window when both proxies align, or 60d returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO indicates stronger production capacity, stimulating consumer demand and corporate investment, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to outperform baseline when INDPRO is above trend, or IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, elevated FEDFUNDS rates signal higher borrowing costs, compressing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS in tightening phase, or IC > 0.1 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation surge above 255 in CPIAUCSL triggers fears of overheating, leading to market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns stay non-negative despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 255, or p-value > 0.05 in such events.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous peaks in HOUST (demand) and GDPC1 (demand) reflect robust economic activity, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 when both proxies peak, or 60d returns not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor demand (PAYEMS) coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE) signals a healthy labor market, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to rise when both labor indicators align, or IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.
